chapter: Big bands, Depression work and the WPA band
title: Joining Herbert Leary's big swing band, 1935-41
summary: Around 1935 Ernie joined Herbert Leary's big band and stayed until 1941, then returned to Dixieland. The band stayed local with short trips such as Baton Rouge.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: Is there anything else there about your life story that you want to finish up there that you didn't get through?

Well, not too much. Well, I mean after around 1935, that's when I joined Herbert Larry's big swing band then. I stayed with him from... Well, then there's a side of Singapore. Yeah, I joined him from 35 to 41. I stayed with him. And after that then I went back to playing Dixieland music again.
Did you travel with that band?
No, they're mostly the local band around here. They ain't going nowhere. Outside, you know, short trips like the Baton Rouge or LSU or something like that. Carpetal College.
